title: 3 Things To Set Up Before You Use Claude
description: If you are using Claude without setting up your profile, connectors, and memory, you are getting maybe 10% of what it can actually do. This video walks through the three settings that turn Claude from a basic chatbot into something that knows your business, pulls from your real tools, and remembers everything across every conversation. Takes about five minutes to set up. Changes the tool completely.
